The Knights of Lordaeron was the collective name given to the knights serving the kingdom of Lordaeron. On the battlefields, they represented the fiercest fighting force in the Alliance armies. They were renowned for cutting bloody swathes through enemy ranks, with their speed and mobility marking them as some of the most versatile warriors of the Alliance of Lordaeron. Astride great warhorses, these honorable and just warriors served as a symbol of order to the peoples of Lordaeron during the Second War. Most of them were eventually slaughtered by the Undead Scourge during the Third War.

Kol Brunkrag was an earthen foreman who led the town of Taelloch and its mine. Shortly preceding the arrival of Dalaran at Khaz Algar, Brunkrag's mind was warped during an encounter with High Speaker Eirich, an experience she described as being "altered." Through a series of messages left for those she led, Brunkrag exposited that she had been chosen by the High Speaker, and that the townspeople should also prepare for an incursion by the skardyn. In her final message, she spoke angrily of "ringing" that filled her mind, and attempted to warn Taelloch of the High Speaker's true intent. The kobyss are a vicious amphibious race resembling large humanoid anglerfish that live deep in the Undersea in Khaz Algar. They are descended from ankoan, making them distant relatives to jinyu and murlocs. The kobyss pose a constant threat to the Hallowfall Arathi, emerging from the Undersea to raid settlements in Hallowfall to eat or necromantically reanimate the dead.
Kobyss Spears are found on the ground and drop from Murkfin Ravagers, Murkfin Sciomancers, and Murkfin Depthstalkers in Velhan's Claim in Hallowfall. Aemyra Acton wants them.

Kol'anji was the chieftain of the Vilebranch tribe who resided within Zul'Aman. Under the belief that the ruling family had led the Amani tribes to ruin, he protested Zul'jarra's ascension and issued the right of challenge. Zarama honored his request and prepared to fight on her daughter's behalf. Zul'jarra sought to gain Akil'zon's blessing to ward off Kol'anji's challenge, but returned too late and watched as he killed Zarama. The Vilebranch chieftain intended to continue the fight, but was struck down by Zul'jarra, who asserted that she was the new chieftain of the Amani and forest tribes.

Kor Dawnchaser is one of the twin sons of Sunwalker Dezco and Leza Dawnchaser. He and his brother, Cloudhoof, were born in the Krasarang Wilds, and their mother died in childbirth. Their father carried them with him at all times in baskets strapped to his back and chest. He was called Redhorn as a "weaning name", and when he came of age he was given his true name. Dezco named his twins after a deceased old friend and a hero who helped him in the Krasarang Wilds.

Kriegval was one of the first of the earthen to abandon their Edicts and become Unbound. He is also the first earthen to choose to shut down permanently. Mourning Rise and Kriegval's Rest were named to honor and commemorate him. Before he became one of the Unbound he was a Stonebound overseer. Kriegval's Rest was built by him and his workers and was originally supposed to be a transport depot that would serve as the connective distribution channel to Wenbrandt's refinery terminal (which later became Cinderbrew Meadery).

Ksvir the Forgotten is an iron vrykul located in the Forgotten Vault on the Siren Isle during storms. By the time of the Great Sundering, Ksvir the Thundered was known as second only to the might of Cyrce and wielded the blessing of Storms, a rumored gift bestowed by Thorim himself. When the naga attacked the isle and the vrykul were forced to retreat to the vault, Valwen turned to Ksvir help heal Thrayir, Eyes of the Siren. Anguished yet bound by oath as Cyrce command to lead her retreat, Ksvir lent Valwen his gift. To stabilize Thrayir's wounds, they forged five runekeys to harness the tempest that roiled above. Ksvir would keep one runekey, while the rest were scattered.

Ky'veza's Etheric Cache is left behind after fending off (or dying to) Nexus-Princess Ky'veza when she invades randomly in a delve during The War Within Season 3. It contains: *Delver's Bounty if not already obtained for the week *~120 Undercoin *35 Valorstones *45 Resonance Crystals *Gear up to Champion 2 (ilvl 684) from Tier 8+ delves
